about: Golden set for ProactiveAgent's conflict judge (proactive_conflict@v1). Each case is a newly confirmed decision and ONE earlier confirmed decision of the same org (the candidate the agent would show the judge). contradicts: both cannot stand at the same time and the new decision does not say it replaces the earlier one. Categories: contradicting (a real clash), superseding (the new decision's own wording knowingly replaces, moves or reverses the earlier one; not a conflict), related (same project or topic, compatible), unrelated (different subject, sometimes similar words). Labels are the maintainer's judgement, written before any model was run against them.
